## Learning goals

By the end of this unit:

- I will be able to compare Linux distributions for a specific computer and user.
- I will be able to prepare for and complete an approved Linux Mint installation.
- I will be able to identify the network information needed for later troubleshooting.

This is important because it enables me to install, test, and support a computer without guessing.

## Start here

1. [Choose a Linux distribution](choosing-a-distribution.qmd).
2. [Install Linux Mint](install-linux-mint.qmd) on a teacher-approved computer.
3. Record the computer name, wired or wireless connection, Internet Protocol address, gateway, and Domain Name System servers for the networking lesson.

::: {.callout-warning title="Before changing a drive"}
An operating-system installation can erase files and existing partitions. Use only the assigned computer and installer. Stop for teacher confirmation before any step that changes a drive.
:::
